name: Learning from Failure (failure-case loop enhanced OpenCUA agent)

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Application-specific keyboard shortcuts for LibreOffice Calc / Writer are also injected when relevant.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled from modules (terminal reminder, libreoffice hints) toggled by flags.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: an MLLM observes the current computer state (e.g., a screenshot) and predicts the next action conditioned on the task instruction

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the agent emits the exact same PyAutoGUI code multiple times in a row
tool_call_format.note: Action space is pyautogui code (--action_space pyautogui default).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: export OPENAI_API_KEY=<% PUT-YOUR-OPENAI-KEY-HERE %>    # OpenAI key (used by the search tool)
edit_primitive.note: GUI/computer-use agent; only computer.search and pyautogui/terminal actions listed, no file-edit primitive.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Removes the `computer.search` tool from the agent's action space
tool_schema_source.note: Action space described in hand-authored prompts (mm_agents/prompts).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The agent can invoke a `computer.search` tool to query an advanced LLM for external knowledge or command syntax.
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned in README or evidence files.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the framework extracts a fixed-size region centered at the target location and generates a zoomed-in view
loop_primitives.note: react loop plus verify-and-revise (coordinate verification, repetition recovery).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: which use a single agent to perform both planning and control

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: which use a single agent to perform both planning and control

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **No Interaction with User**: You MUST complete the task individually. There is **NO** additional input from someone else.
human_in_loop.note: Human verification occurs offline on code patches, not in-run.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: parser.add_argument("--history_n", type=int, default=5, help="The max number of images in the history.")

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The resulting plug-and-play recipe operates entirely at inference time, requiring no additional training or data collection
long_term_memory.note: Improvements persist as code patches, not agent-readable memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The agent is then prompted to verify its action conditioned on the cropped screenshot, task instruction, action history, and ongoing reasoning context

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the main results are the mean±standard deviation across 3 independent runs
retry_policy.note: Independent runs are for measurement, not retry policy.

rollback.evidence_quote: the agent is encouraged to reformulate its plan or switch to an alternative interaction strategy
rollback.note: Recovery is prompt-level; no environment rollback described.

termination_condition.note: agent.done()/agent.fail() model-declared; repetition/screen-change detection triggers recovery mode.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Default TTL minutes for instance auto-termination (cloud-side scheduler)
timeouts.note: VM TTL 180 min default; no per-tool timeout found in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Follow the official OSWorld instructions to set up a VMware, VirtualBox, or Docker environment:
execution_isolation.note: run script default provider_name="aws" (cloud VM); docker also selectable.

network_policy.evidence_quote: a search-engine interface that fetches relevant information beyond the model's internal context window
network_policy.note: No network restriction found in evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: - **Use One Provided Action at a Time**: Execute only one grounded action per turn.
permission_model.note: No authorisation layer; emitted pyautogui code is executed.

tracing.note: Trajectories (instruction, action history, thought) are stored and fed to the LLM judge.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: description="Run end-to-end evaluation on the benchmark"
eval_hooks.note: OSWorld evaluation harness ships in repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The agent will no longer crop the click target and ask the model to verify/adjust the coordinate before executing.
guardrails.note: Pre-execution coordinate verification can alter/block the action.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Learning from Failure: Inference-Time Self-Improvement for Computer-Use Agents

open_source.note: No LICENSE file in evidence; code public.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we apply the same failure-driven self-improvement loop to models of different capacities and origins

first_release_date.note: No tags; basis is paper v1 date.
